report_name: AI-Powered Cyberattacks Hit Major US Corporations in 2026

threat_actors.name: AI-leveraging Threat Actors
threat_actors.description: A collection of various threat actors incorporating AI into their toolkits for social engineering, reconnaissance, and ransomware deployment against U.S. corporations in 2026.

threat_actors.name: Iranian-linked group
threat_actors.description: An Iranian-linked threat group that conducted a cyberattack against Stryker, which involved wiping devices.

attack_patterns.name: Phishing
attack_patterns.description: AI was used to craft highly convincing and personalized phishing emails to enhance social engineering campaigns.

attack_patterns.name: Masquerading
attack_patterns.description: Attackers used AI to create deepfake audio/video for impersonation attacks, as seen in the breach at the law firm Blank Rome where an attorney was tricked by IT impersonation.

attack_patterns.name: Active Scanning
attack_patterns.description: AI tools were used for automated reconnaissance to rapidly scan for and identify vulnerabilities in public-facing assets.

attack_patterns.name: Data Encrypted for Impact
attack_patterns.description: Ransomware was deployed in attacks against companies like Nike and Wynn Resorts, where AI may have been used to guide the deployment to critical assets for maximum impact.

attack_patterns.name: Exfiltration Over C2 Channel
attack_patterns.description: In the attack against Nike, 1.4 TB of company data was exfiltrated and subsequently leaked online.

attack_patterns.name: Exploit Public-Facing Application
attack_patterns.description: Widespread attacks targeted vulnerabilities in public-facing Fortinet firewall/VPN devices, affecting approximately 75,000 systems.

attack_patterns.name: Data Destruction
attack_patterns.description: An Iranian-linked group wiped devices during a cyberattack against the healthcare company Stryker.

attack_patterns.name: Spearphishing via Social Engineering LLM
attack_patterns.description: Attackers used AI to craft highly convincing and personalized phishing emails for social engineering campaigns.

identities.name: Nike
identities.description: Victim of a ransomware attack where 1.4 TB of company data was exfiltrated and leaked online.

identities.name: Wynn Resorts
identities.description: Victim of a ransomware attack involving the theft of employee information and a ~$1.5 million ransom demand.

identities.name: Coca-Cola
identities.description: Victim of a cyberattack that halted production at several facilities due to system compromise.

identities.name: Stryker
identities.description: Victim of a cyberattack by an Iranian-linked group that disrupted order processing and involved devices being wiped.

identities.name: West Pharmaceutical
identities.description: Victim of a ransomware attack that resulted in data theft and a system lockdown impacting global operations.

identities.name: Blank Rome
identities.description: Victim of a social engineering attack where an attorney was tricked by IT impersonation, leading to client data exposure.

identities.name: Take-Two Interactive
identities.description: Victim of a data breach where 80 million business records were allegedly stolen from an analytics provider.

identities.name: Instructure
identities.description: Victim of a data breach that exposed data from thousands of educational institutions using its Canvas platform.

identities.name: Fortinet
identities.description: Vendor whose firewall/VPN devices were targeted in widespread vulnerability exploit attacks, affecting approximately 75,000 systems.

identities.name: Bumble
identities.description: Victim of a data breach where user contact information was exposed.

identities.name: Match
identities.description: Victim of a data breach where user contact information was exposed.

identities.name: Panera Bread
identities.description: Victim of a data breach where user contact information was exposed.
